evals.prompt: Write a getting started guide for KitStack. I want a developer to go from zero to having a working kit with one tool and one view running locally. Target someone who knows TypeScript but has never seen KitStack before.
evals.expected_output: A complete .mdx getting-started tutorial with prerequisites, step-by-step instructions, code blocks with filenames, and working inline examples derived from the actual SDK API.

assertions.text: Includes terminal/CLI commands for running locally
Has a Next Steps section at the end

assertions.description: At least 3 headings start with action verbs (Create, Install, Configure, Add, Define, Run, Build, Set)

evals.prompt: Write the API reference page for defineTool(). Cover the full signature, all parameters including load/handler/authorize, return type, and show examples of read-only tools vs write tools. Make sure the gotchas around naming conventions and description length are in there.
evals.expected_output: A complete .mdx API reference page with accurate type signature from source, parameter table, return type docs, multiple code examples, and warning callouts for naming/validation constraints.

assertions.text: Has a TypeScript function signature block
Has a parameter table with columns
Shows a load() example for read-only tools
Shows a handler() example for write tools
Uses Warning or similar callout for gotchas

evals.prompt: Write a guide on how to add views to a kit. Cover the loader pattern, the View component, useKit hook, and how views respond to tool mutations. Show a realistic example like a contacts table view.
evals.expected_output: A complete .mdx how-to guide covering the full view lifecycle (loader → component → interactivity), with realistic code examples based on existing kits, proper MDX callouts for gotchas, and links to related concepts.
